**Summary**  
The GNN-A model ranks ribosome-biogenesis and translation pathways (rRNA modification/processing, tRNA aminoacylation, translation termination, mRNA capping) as most driven by C3L-01287’s tumor proteome [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-6790901], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-6791226], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-379716], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-72764], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-72086]. New subgraph edges directly link several of the patient’s top dysregulated proteins to these and complementary pathways: cytosolic tRNA aminoacylation (via DARS1, IARS1, QARS1, LARS1, EPRS1, MARS1, RARS1, GARS1, KARS1) [E3806228], [E3811708], [E3798994], [E3808932], [E3819200], [E3802457], [E188640], [E133772]; purine biosynthesis (via PPAT) [E3813795]; HIF-1α signaling (via PDK1) [E3752082]; VHL-associated hypoxia response and RHOBTB3 ATPase cycle [E3776797], [E3825753]; mTORC1 amino-acid sensing (via ATP6V subunits) [E3801675], [E3812663], [E3832186], [E3792851], [E3812214]; and TFAP2A-mediated repression (via NOP2) [E3810209].

**Evidence paths**  
- Model-ranked pathway scores from the patient’s tumor proteome [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-6790901], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-6791226], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-379716], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-72764], [rank:C3L-01287:pathway:REACT:R-HSA-72086].  
- Patient’s up-regulated DARS1 participates in cytosolic tRNA aminoacylation and aspartyl-tRNA aminoacylation, and interacts with IARS1 and LARS1 [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:1615], [E64025], [E225079], [E3752875], [E3806228].  
- Up-regulated PPAT catalyzes amidophosphoribosyltransferase activity in purine ribonucleoside monophosphate biosynthesis [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:5471], [E3549249], [E3813795].  
- Up-regulated PDK1 localizes to mitochondria, binds SRC, and drives HIF-1α signaling [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:5163], [E3587238], [E152191], [E3752082].  
- Somatic VHL mutation (p.N141fs) and up-regulated NOP2 localize to nucleoplasm; VHL negatively regulates hypoxic transcription and engages RHOBTB3 ATPase cycle; NOP2 participates in TFAP2A repression [pt:C3L-01287:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428], [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:4839], [E3587363], [E3598872], [E3598268], [E3776797], [E3825753], [E3810209].  
- Up-regulated CIT, FXYD1, GNE, PRMT3, EGFR link to neuron generation, membrane potential/glutathionylation, sialuria pathway, metal-ion binding, and chromatin binding respectively [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:11113], [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:5348], [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:10020], [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:10196], [pt:C3L-01287:protein_up:NCBIGene:1956], [E3745771], [E3724777], [E3760927], [E3791963], [E3503990], [E3516514].  
- Down-regulated CORO2B binds talin at focal adhesions; ATP6V0A4 (V-ATPase subunit) connects to mTORC1 amino-acid sensing via other ATP6V subunits [pt:C3L-01287:protein_down:NCBIGene:10391], [pt:C3L-01287:protein_down:NCBIGene:50617], [E3552190], [E3613721], [E3801675], [E3812663], [E3832186], [E3792851], [E3812214].
